title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Knowledge Work
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation can ground generated answers in a changing knowledge base and expose supporting passages for enterprise knowledge work.
limitations: Answer quality depends on retrieval coverage and source freshness.
The system still needs evaluation for unsupported claims.

title: Context Selection and Ranking in Long-Document Retrieval
abstract: Adding more retrieved context does not always improve an answer; irrelevant or poorly ordered passages can distract a model, so selection and ranking remain important.
limitations: Long-document behavior can vary with context order.
Retrieval scores alone do not prove answer correctness.

title: Evaluating Factuality and Citation Coverage in RAG Systems
abstract: Evaluation should separate retrieval quality, answer correctness and citation completeness; a high retrieval score alone does not guarantee a grounded answer.
limitations: Evaluation metrics may disagree across domains.
Citation completeness does not replace human review of important claims.

title: Human Review for High-Stakes Research Assistants
abstract: Human review is useful for high-impact research decisions because automated systems may miss ambiguous evidence or outdated policies.
limitations: Review introduces operational cost and latency.
Reviewers need clear evidence and escalation criteria.

title: Metadata and Access Control for Organizational Search
abstract: Organizational retrieval needs metadata filters and permission checks; without them, relevant context can be excluded or unauthorized content can be exposed.
limitations: Permission metadata must remain synchronized with source systems.
Strict filters can reduce recall for legitimate users.

title: Operational Monitoring of Knowledge Assistants
abstract: Knowledge assistants require monitoring for retrieval drift, stale documents and changes in source quality; maintenance is an ongoing part of deployment.
limitations: Maintenance effort grows with the number of connected sources.
